charts.title: LTT 3780 c: orbits around LTT 3780
charts.description: The orbits of LTT 3780's planets in this map from above, to scale, with LTT 3780 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Weisserman et al. 2026 (2026A&A...709A.165W), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname WEISSERMAN_ET_AL_2026): P 12.25228 d

charts.title: LTT 3780 c: its transit
charts.description: LTT 3780 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (62, 89, 100) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 36724087, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 6-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 6-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
